import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorder_data = df.copy()
sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'] = sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
for disorder in sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    subset = sleep_disorder_data[sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
               label=disorder, alpha=0.6, s=50)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder')
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
top_occupations = occupation_sleep.tail(8)
ax2.barh(range(len(top_occupations)), top_occupations.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(top_occupations)))
ax2.set_yticklabels(top_occupations.index, fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlabel('Avg Sleep Duration (hrs)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Physical Activity vs Stress Level (heatmap style)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
activity_bins = pd.cut(df['Physical Activity Level'], bins=5)
stress_bins = pd.cut(df['Stress Level'], bins=5)
heatmap_data = pd.crosstab(stress_bins, activity_bins)
sns.heatmap(heatmap_data, annot=True, fmt='d', cmap='YlOrRd', ax=ax3, cbar_kws={'label': 'Count'})
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax3.set_yticklabels(ax3.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=8)

# 4. BMI Category Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors_bmi = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1', '#FFA07A']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90,
                                     colors=colors_bmi[:len(bmi_counts)])
ax4.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 5. Heart Rate Distribution by Gender
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df_gender = df[df['Gender'].isin(['Male', 'Female'])]
for gender in df_gender['Gender'].unique():
    subset = df_gender[df_gender['Gender'] == gender]
    ax5.hist(subset['Heart Rate'], alpha=0.6, label=gender, bins=20, edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate Distribution by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend()
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 6. Daily Steps vs Sleep Quality
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
scatter = ax6.scatter(df['Daily Steps'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                     c=df['Physical Activity Level'], cmap='viridis', 
                     alpha=0.6, s=50)
ax6.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Daily Steps vs Sleep Quality', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax6)
cbar.set_label('Physical Activity', fontsize=9)
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 7. Age Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
ax7.hist(df['Age'], bins=20, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.axvline(df['Age'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Mean: {df["Age"].mean():.1f}')
ax7.legend()
ax7.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 8. Stress Level by Sleep Disorder
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
sleep_disorder_stress = df.copy()
sleep_disorder_stress['Sleep Disorder'] = sleep_disorder_stress['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorder_order = sleep_disorder_stress.groupby('Sleep Disorder')['Stress Level'].median().sort_values().index
sns.boxplot(data=sleep_disorder_stress, y='Sleep Disorder', x='Stress Level', 
            order=disorder_order, palette='Set2', ax=ax8)
ax8.set_xlabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_ylabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Stress Level by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
